title: Studio photograph of three edwardian men
description: On this photo we can see three dapper men in typical everyday attire from late 1900s or early 1910s. There's a range of different accessories here, bowties and a tie, watch chains, boutonieres and pocket squares or handkerchieves.

title: Joseph Pujol in morning attire
description: In this photo we can see a typical edwardian morning attire consisting of morning coat and trousers, a stiff club collar and a tie. Joseph is wearing a shiny oxfords and a pocket square.
